newsitem.title: UK: N.Ireland police probe shooting of Catholic girl.
newsitem.headline: N.Ireland police probe shooting of Catholic girl.

text.p: A young Catholic girl was shot and wounded in Northern Ireland early on Tuesday and police said they were investigating the motive for the attack.
The incident happened at around 0400 a.m. (0300 GMT) in the staunchly Protestant village of Aghalee some 30 miles (50 km) southwest of Belfast.
Hospital sources said the girl, who was believed to be 18 years old, had facial injuries.
Residents of the village said the girl had a Protestant boyfriend. No further details were immediately available.
The shooting occured at a period of high tension between Protestants and Catholics after days of Catholic rioting last week over Orange Order parades.
